newsitem.title: USA: American Express acquires accounting firm divisions.
newsitem.headline: American Express acquires accounting firm divisions.

text.p: American Express Co. said Wednesday its tax and business services subsidiary acquired the tax and business division of one of Chicago's largest accounting firms, continuing its strategy of expanding by acquiring prominent local firms.
American Express said it acquired the advisory, tax and business and technology divisions of Checkers, Simon & Rosner LLP. Terms were not disclosed.
American Express Co. has doubled the size of its tax and business services organisation since January, the company said.
Including this acquisition, American Express has bought accounting firms with nearly $50 million in annual revenues. Wednesday's acquisition was the largest to date.

"The marketplace is becoming increasingly demanding and competitive for accounting firms," said Bob Basten, president and chief executive of American Express Tax & Business Services. "Combining the personal services of a local firm with the support of a large corporation strengthens the ability to meet clients' needs."
The acquisition is subject to approval by the Federal Trade Commission
The acquired divisions will be named the Chicago Metro Area office of American Express Tax & Business Services.

The office will offer business services such as employee benefits, business and technology consulting, tax planning and compliance, retirement planning, bookkeeping, estate planning and litigation support, American Express said. The company said business clients seek more "non-traditional" services.
The Chicago office will be the company's fourth site to offer credit services.
American Express Tax & Business Services has more than 50 offices in 21 states. The company said it is carrying out its plan to expand by acquiring prominent local firms.

The acquisition is the company's first involving one of the top 30 accounting firms nationwide, American Express said. Checkers, Simon & Rosner, which is privately held and has nearly 220 employees, will continue to operate as an independent public accounting firm.
American Express is a diversified worldwide travel and financial services company founded in 1850.
